academie_queue.supports: Defines a queue as a line of people waiting their turn, supporting the French file d’attente wording.
academie_queue.title: Académie française, Dictionnaire: queue

arabic_media.supports: Defines وسائل الإعلام using newspapers, radio, television, and other mass communication outlets; it does not name a requested media item.
arabic_media.title: Cairo Academy of the Arabic Language, Dictionary: وسائل الإعلام

arabic_space.supports: Defines المساحة as a measurable area; the caller shows storage capacity, so the candidate specifies storage.
arabic_space.title: Cairo Academy of the Arabic Language, Dictionary: المساحة

duden_name_compound.supports: D146 uses hyphens in compounds with multi-part names and gives “Rio-de-la-Plata-Bucht” as an example. This supports German “Open-Library-ID”; the checker requiring the exact space-separated phrase “Open Library” is overbroad for this compound.
duden_name_compound.title: Duden, Rechtschreibregeln: Namen, D146

duden_storage.supports: Defines storage capacity as the capacity of a storage device, matching the root-folder table values.
duden_storage.title: Duden, Speicherkapazität

moe_houxuanren.supports: Defines 候選人 as a person awaiting votes, not an ISBN candidate item.
moe_houxuanren.title: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary: 候選人

moe_ji.supports: Lists a television program example counted in seasons, supporting 季 for a television season.
moe_ji.title: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary: 季

moe_jijie.supports: Defines 季節 as a period in the year characterized by climate/agriculture, explaining why it is wrong for a TV series season.
moe_jijie.title: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Revised Mandarin Chinese Dictionary: 季節

musicbrainz.supports: Official product spelling; preserve the product name and ID label.
musicbrainz.title: MusicBrainz official site

openlibrary.supports: Official product spelling; preserve the two-word brand.
openlibrary.title: Open Library official site

rae_partido.supports: In the automatic edition-matching context, partido means a sports/game match; coincidencia is the intended software match.
rae_partido.title: Real Academia Española, Diccionario de la lengua española: partido, partida

rae_usted.supports: Spanish direct address in formal usted uses the usted verbal forms; the es proposals use Su and usted-form verbs.
rae_usted.title: Real Academia Española, Gramática: treatment pronouns and agreement
